### Added

- (agent-platform) [Show Missing from git and Pending erase on the organization page](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3460) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — An organization's page says when the organization is `Missing from git`, with a link to the last commit that held its file, `Pending erase` once its delete pull request merged, then `Erasing` while it is deleted.
- (agent-platform) [Read organizations from list_organizations and offer changes by the person's access](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3467) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — The Organizations pages also list organizations you manage without being a member, and an organization's page offers adding members, `Add model` and `Replace key` or `Replace credential` only to people allowed to make that change. Needs agent-manager 2.24.0.
- (agent-platform) [List wizard plugins as rows by format, with folded skills and a whole-package checkbox](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3475) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On the agent wizard's Skills step, plugins are listed in two groups, `Claude Code plugins` and `Agent Plugins` packages, each with its skills folded away, a checkbox that picks a whole package and a search over plugins and skills.

### Changed

- (muster) [Share useMusterServerAvailability between the Agent Platform and Bot PRs](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3446) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — Bot PRs no longer waits on an installation the portal can't reach, as the Agent Platform pages already didn't.

### Fixed

- (muster) [Fail fast on installations the portal cannot reach](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3433) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — Agent Platform pages no longer wait about 20 seconds on every visit for an installation the portal can't reach: it is reported as not reachable at once, and one slow answer no longer marks it so.

### Development and CI/CD

- (e2e) [Agentlab specs follow the lab's organizations and default model](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3466) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — The agentlab specs that create an agent pick the lab's organization and keep the wizard's default model, so they pass on a lab with organizations again.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.36.1...v3.37.0
